chunks: Zayd al-Shahham narrated; he said: Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said to me:
Whoever entrusts you with a trust, then deliver it back to him; and whoever betrays you, do not betray him.

key_terms.ائْتَمَنَكَ: entrusted you with something for safekeeping
key_terms.بِأَمَانَةٍ: with a trust or deposited property
key_terms.خَانَكَ: betrayed you or acted treacherously toward you
key_terms.فَلَا تَخُنْهُ: then do not betray him in return

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about returning a trust and responding to betrayal?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the obligation of fulfilling trusts and maintaining integrity in dealings with others. It also instructs that another person’s betrayal does not justify responding with betrayal, establishing a standard of moral restraint and honesty.
